name: zcode-hud
description: WezTerm-aligned wallpaper theme plus the animated zusage status bar (vendored upstream v1.5.19): live tok/s capsule, per-answer rate line, context ring. One atomic app.asar injection; trigger-driven local query process; no hooks, no auto-update, no MCP.
